name: EnergyConsumptionMonitor
tagline: kWh per unit by line, tariff bands, baseline vs actual and CO2e – with idle-load alerts.
description: An advanced PCF control for manufacturers that turns hourly meter readings and production counts into energy intensity per line, compares it with baselines and targets, prices it with time-of-use tariff bands, estimates CO2e and flags idle-load and high-intensity hours for review – in Canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: KPI strip: energy, kWh/unit vs baseline, cost and peak share, CO2e, anomalies
Line cards with baseline and target markers and daily sparklines
Day × hour heatmap with tariff band strip
Trend of daily kWh/unit vs baseline and target
Idle-load and high-intensity anomaly detection with acknowledgement notes
Phone sheet, tablet and desktop layouts
State JSON, outputs and DOM event for automation
